title_en: Character Riddles (18/20): A Figure Flashing Past the Door
note_en: Doubling a verb with 一 in the middle, as in 一闪一闪, describes an action repeating on and off: 星星在夜空中一闪一闪的 "the stars twinkle in the night sky," 老路灯常常一闪一闪地亮 "the old streetlight often flickered." Compare the set phrase 一闪而过, "to flash past," where a single 一 marks one quick, instantaneous action.
